description: This file defines a Flask route for health checking, utilizing Flask-Smorest's Blueprint and Flask's MethodView to create a health endpoint that returns a simple health status message.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask MethodView class that handles GET requests for the health check endpoint.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests and returns a JSON indicating the service health status.
